messages:
jamie (product): quick sync — need final acceptance criteria for the API work (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank). customers asking for exact guarantees before we flip the flag.

alex (eng): ok, what level? perf SLAs, error modes, or contract shape?

jamie (product): all of the above. propose we capture: 1) request/response contract + schema examples for streaming and non-streaming, 2) latency targets (p50/p95) per SKU, 3) deterministic fallback behavior when model variant not available, 4) edge-case test cases (truncation, long context, incompatible tools), 5) rollout gating criteria (canary pass conditions).

ravi (eng-ml): from ML side: also include quality regression checks for embeddings and rerank — small eval harness with threshold knobs. we should tie automated checks to the rollout.

maria (design): add acceptance for structured outputs too — examples where function-calls or tool-output must be validated. UX wants predictable error responses so SDKs can handle them.

alex (eng): drafting a short smoke test plan now. rough items:
- health check: /v1/models responds with model version + quantization tag
- chat streaming sanity: header chunking, end-of-stream marker present
- completions token limits: request 100k char prompt -> returns 4xx with clear error
- embeddings stability: identical inputs -> within epsilon cosine similarity
- rerank deterministic fallback: if quality score < threshold, return base ranking + note

jamie (product): love it. can we write explicit acceptance assertions so QA can automate? eg: p95 latency < 200ms for small chat (<=512 tokens) on hosted tier. p95 < 700ms for dedicated small-gpu SKU.

alex (eng): we can assert those in k6/gatling. need historical baseline; i'll run a quick sweep and attach numbers.

ravi (eng-ml): for embeddings similarity: acceptance = avg cosine(delta) < 0.005 over 1k sample pairs post-quantization. if exceeded, fail rollout.

maria (design): sample error payloads please — we need canonical keys: {"code","message","retryable","details"} so frontends don't parse ad-hoc.

jamie (product): good point. canonical error format and documented examples. also acceptance: SDK surfaces these fields unchanged.

taylor (pm): can we agree on rollout gates? suggested:
- canary: 1% traffic for 24h, automated smoke tests pass, no SEV from canary users
- ramp: 10% for 6h, monitoring ok
- full: 100% after 48h without regressions
Also manual rollback if quality eval fails at any point.

alex (eng): implement canary policy + automatic fallback to previous model variant on errors. add alert when error rate delta > 0.5% absolute.

ravi (eng-ml): define quality eval harness: repo with prompt set + scoring script. acceptance: new model must not drop retrieval/rerank NDCG by >0.5% on core suite.

maria (design): one more edge case: function calling mismatch — if model returns unknown function name, API should return 400 with guidance and not execute. include example.

jamie (product): agreed. also include data residency note for private deployments — acceptance tests should run against VPC-deployed endpoint variants.

deploy-bot: note: deploy pipeline job #4128 queued for canary when spec lands in main.

alex (eng): action items: I will push a first-pass PR with the acceptance checklist and smoke test scripts by EOD. tagging @ravi and @maria for the quality and UX payload samples.

ravi (eng-ml): I will add the eval harness and baseline metrics.

maria (design): will post canonical error/structured-output examples in the doc and update SDK UX notes.

jamie (product): thanks — once PR is ready, we'll schedule a 30-min sign-off tomorrow. goal: ship gating + rollout policy into the PRD so eng can start implementation. :thumbsup:

alex (eng): sounds good. posting initial PR link in thread when ready.

jamie (product): perfect. closing loop — include acceptance criteria matrix in PRD: endpoints x criteria (contract, latency, quality, error handling, rollout).
